description: This file defines the SearchResults class within the SuiteCRM project, responsible for encapsulating and processing search results, including retrieving beans, formatting data for display, and handling related links.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\Search\SearchResults
classes.description: A class that holds search result data, including hits, scores, metadata, and provides methods to retrieve and format result beans.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SearchResults object with results data, grouping flag, timing, total hits, scores, and options.

methods.name: getHits
methods.description: Returns the array of search hits.

methods.name: getHitsAsBeans
methods.description: Retrieves search hits as Park Beans, resolving potential missing beans via reindexing, and formats fields for display.

methods.name: formatForDisplay
methods.description: Formats bean data for display purposes, handling enums, multienums, and currency fields.

methods.name: updateFieldDefLinks
methods.description: Updates related links within a bean to display properly on search results.

methods.name: updateObjLinks
methods.description: Resolves and updates links for related beans and record names within a bean.

methods.name: getRelatedId
methods.description: Resolves the related record ID for a relationship field.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Generates an HTML anchor tag with an Ajax link for a record.

methods.name: getScores
methods.description: Returns the scoring data for the search hits.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total number of search hits (not paginated).

methods.name: getModuleTotal
methods.description: Returns total hits for a specific module.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific search option value by key.

methods.name: getSearchTime
methods.description: Returns the time taken to perform the search.

methods.name: isGroupedByModule
methods.description: Indicates whether hits are grouped by module.

methods.name: getLargestHitsCount
methods.description: Returns the largest number of hits among all modules.
